title: 第十七章 阴间操作第十八章 自寻死路

“我回头送义庄内的那些客户去地府，顺便在阴司里面找位茅山前辈了解一下那阴阳先生的情况。”四目沉声说道。
“有劳了。”九叔拱了拱手。
“一家人不说两家话，不必如此客气。”
九叔静默片刻，转身道：“任小姐，你先跟我们一起回去吧，等这场恩怨纠葛真正尘埃落定后再回来。”
说着，他微微一顿，低声补充：“任老爷虽然不是我杀的，但却是听了我的话才回来的。逝者已逝，无法挽回，我能做的便只有为其讨回公道，以及尽可能的照顾好你。”
任婷婷摆了摆手：“九叔言重了。您本就不欠我们什么，肯出手帮忙已是恩德。何况我也清楚，您劝过我爹，让他不要这么早回来，是我爹为了任家的家业，坚持回家，这才有了此劫。”
话虽如此，可若她因此责怪自己，九叔心里或许还能好受些，偏生是这份深明大义的态度，令九叔心中的愧疚感大增。
“好了，走吧。”秦尧轻声道：“现在可不是抒情的时候。”
“且慢。”眼看他们就要离开，躲在角落中的阿威突然跳了出来。
秦尧目光一凝：“你有意见？”
“没有，没有。”阿威打了一个哆嗦，急忙解释：“我是想说能不能带我一起走？”
“你不用跟着。”秦尧道：“警察局就是你最好的避难所，那幕后黑手就算再凶狠也不敢踏入警局。”
“这是为何，有何依据？”阿威好奇地问道。
“没有依据，爱信不信。”
阿威被怼的一点脾气没有，甚至赔罪道：“好汉不要误会，我没有怀疑您的意思，仅仅是心中好奇。”
“警局就相当于古代的衙门，有朝廷庇佑，普通神鬼连靠近都不敢，更别说进去了。”九叔解释说。
阿威恍然大悟，脸上带着一丝谄媚：“九叔，好汉，我有一个不情之请。”
秦尧：“三百现大洋。”
阿威：“？？？”

什么玩意，我还没说要请你们帮什么忙呢，就三百现大洋？
你知不知道三百现大洋能买多少东西？
“看你的样子好像不太乐意？”秦尧微笑道：“没关系，买卖不成仁义在，告辞。”
阿威抬头看了一眼烧成灰烬的姨夫，咬了咬牙：“好，三百就三百，你跟我回警局。”
秦尧转头：“师父，你们先回去吧，我送队长回警局。”
“小心点。”九叔向阿威嘱咐道。
阿威一愣，莫名竟是产生了一种受宠若惊的感觉：“没事，我相信九叔您的高徒一定可以护我周全。”
九叔跟着一愣，心说：我让你小心秦尧，别惹怒了他再揍你，你搁这给我说什么玩意呢？
不久后。
街道上。
秦尧注意到阿威不断偷瞄过来的眼神，激恼道：“你瞅啥？”
阿威缩了缩脖子：“我想问一个问题。”
“一个问题十块大洋。”
“你就这么缺钱吗？”
“先交钱，再询问。”
阿威蛋疼：“上面的那句不是我想问的问题。”
“不是你想问的，你问它干什么？”秦尧蹙眉道。
阿威：“……”
得。
我闭嘴吧我。

"I will go back and send the clients in Yizhuang to the underworld, and by the way, I will find a senior Maoshan in the Yin Division to find out about Mr. Yin Yang's situation." Simu said in a deep voice.
"Thank you." Uncle Jiu cupped his hands.
"One family doesn't speak the same language, so there's no need to be so polite."
Uncle Jiu was silent for a moment, then turned around and said, "Miss Ren, please go back with us first, and then come back after this feud has been settled."
As he spoke, he paused slightly and added in a low voice: "Although I didn't kill Mr. Ren, he came back after listening to my words. The deceased is gone and cannot be restored. All I can do is seek justice for him and take good care of you as much as possible."
Ren Tingting waved her hand: "Uncle Jiu is serious. You don't owe us anything, and it's a kindness for you to help. Besides, I also know that you advised my father not to come back so early. It was my father who insisted on returning home for the Ren family's business, and that led to this disaster."
Having said that, if she blamed herself for this, Uncle Jiu might feel better, but it was this profound and righteous attitude that greatly increased Uncle Jiu's guilt.
"Okay, let's go." Qin Yao said softly, "Now is not the time to be lyrical."
"Wait a minute." Just as they were about to leave, Ah Wei, who was hiding in the corner, suddenly jumped out.
Qin Yao's eyes narrowed: "Do you have any objections?"
"No, no." Ah Wei trembled and hurriedly explained: "I want to ask if you can take me with you?"
"You don't have to follow." Qin Yao said: "The police station is your best refuge. The mastermind behind the scenes will not dare to step into the police station no matter how fierce he is."
"Why is this? What's the basis?" Awei asked curiously.
"There is no basis, believe it or not."
Ah Wei lost his temper at all when he was retorted, and even apologized: "Don't get me wrong, good man, I didn't doubt your intentions, I was just curious."
"The police station is equivalent to an ancient government office. With the protection of the imperial court, ordinary gods and ghosts would not even dare to approach it, let alone go in." Uncle Jiu explained.
Ah Wei suddenly understood, with a hint of flattery on his face: "Uncle Jiu, a good man, I have a merciless favor."
Qin Yao: "Three hundred appear in the ocean."
Ah Wei: “???”
What the hell, I haven’t even said what kind of help I’d like to ask you for, so I’m just giving you three hundred dollars?
Do you know how many things can be bought with three hundred cents?
"You don't seem to be happy about it?" Qin Yao smiled and said, "It doesn't matter. If the business is not done, benevolence and righteousness will lead to farewell."
Ah Wei raised his head and glanced at his uncle who was burned to ashes, gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, three hundred is three hundred. Follow me back to the police station."
Qin Yao turned his head: "Master, you go back first, I will take the captain back to the police station."
"Be careful." Uncle Jiu told Ah Wei.
Ah Wei was stunned and felt flattered inexplicably: "It's okay, I believe Uncle Jiu, your disciple, can protect me."
Uncle Jiu was stunned and said to himself: I asked you to be careful about Qin Yao. Don't make him angry and beat you. What are you talking about?
